title: 第13章 新的食材
content_zh:
第13章新的食材
坠崖得奇遇，这是只有话本小说之中才有的桥段。
杨狱之前怎么都想不到，自家老爷子居然也有这样的机遇，心中一时又喜又忧。
老爷子得了‘奇遇’固然可喜，可那悬崖似乎很高很高，峭壁之上别无它物，无水无食，只怕此时也艰难的很。
“希望老爷子能逢凶化吉，遇难呈祥吧……”
呆愣了好一会，杨狱才叹了口气。
黑山城相距青州路途颇为遥远，一来一回得一年有余，路上道路多变，山多路杂。
哪怕他想要去寻老爷子，暂时也有心无力。
更不必说此时黑山城很有些不太平，自己要是离去，婆婆一个人在这，只怕更危险。
“只是该如何向婆婆解释？”
杨狱揉了揉太阳穴，翻身跳出大纲，伸手自缸边一抹，那断刀已然被他捏在手上。
彻底的炼化之后，他察觉到了不同。
此时握着刀，就有一股水乳交融的感觉涌上心头，似乎刀不仅是刀，而是成了他手臂的一部分。
“彻底炼化，似乎真有不同？”
杨狱精神一震，旋即看向胸口的小鼎。
这段时间的勤奋‘充能’，让这口暴食之鼎哪怕是在断刀彻底炼化后，也只有一小部分还是青色。
这也意味着，快则三五天，慢则八九天，他就能炼化第二件食材了。
这个速度，取决于他自己。
抖落身上的水滴，杨狱持刀在手，在院中挥舞转动。
他右手持刀，左手成掌，眼落刀口，身随刀走，随着刀法变换，时而托刀上架以助刀力，

时而手按刀背左右滚闭，时而屈肘横架，时而斜撩下拉……
一番游走，杨狱只觉断刀如驱臂使，随心所动，说不出的流畅与舒服。
就好似自己真练了三五十年一般。
但未多久，杨狱收刀后退，微微气喘：
“记忆里老爷子一气可以全力挥刀八百次……我的体格，还不如老爷子？”
杨狱想想，还真是。
自己来到这个世界不过一年，前半年都在养身子亏空，后半年也没多刻苦。
真正勤奋的也就这些天而已。
短短时间，就算有药浴，也比不上老爷子打熬了小半辈子的体格。
“我技巧或许不逊老爷子，但力量、速度都差了不少，真个打起来，老爷子怕不是几刀就能杀了我……”
“老爷子只怕也是泡过药浴的，就是不知道是否换血成功？”
胡乱的擦着身子，杨狱心中嘀咕着。
“得搞钱了……”
“该怎么快速赚钱？”
天色蒙蒙亮，杨狱伏在桌前，写写画画。
穿越的一年里，杨狱不止一次想过搞钱。
但都因为种种原因胎死腹中，前世记忆纵有助力，可也抵不过这个世道的牵绊束缚。
“行商、贩卖盐铁、妓院、赌馆、走私、粮食、土地吞并、当官……”
纸上，杨狱将他认为最赚钱的行当，从低到高排列出来。
对比自己的能力，一一划掉。

首先划掉的，是当官。
当官自然是最为赚钱的行当，没有之一。
三年清知府十万雪花银，这话可不是说说而已。
黑山城最有钱的人，不是深耕此城数十年的‘陈、王、李’三家，也不是城外驻守的黑山军。
而是县令‘三尺刘’。
他只当了小十年的县令，已经比那几个士绅有钱的多了。
天高三尺刘文鹏，哪怕在其余几个县，也都是赫赫有名的巨富人物。
其次，则是粮食。
人不可一日无食，能不吃肉，不能不吃粮食，但这条，还是得划掉。
粮食，是三尺刘的禁脔，别人沾不得。
同理，土地吞并也根本没法弄。
再人后，划掉毫无条件的走私，妓院、赌馆，摆在他面前的，只有盐铁和行商了。
“盐铁，行商……”
将这两个选择圈起，杨狱咬着笔筒，沉思着。
大明不禁私营盐铁，从事着不在少数，可这个行当可谓复杂，由内外城几大家乡绅和外城几个帮派共同把持着。
而行商，同样如此。
无论内外城，想要做买卖，哪怕只是摆个摊卖字画，也要上交一成给衙门，其余两成归帮派乡绅。
剩下的，才是自己的。
没有背景，哪怕生意再好，也会被吃的干干净净。
更何况，他也没有那么多时间去经营，更别说外出进货了。

盐铁同样，他虽然有着更高效提炼盐铁的方法，但哪里有底本？
魏老头那么些弟子，不也只有胡万等几人活的滋润，其他，也都尽是些苦哈哈。
“难啊，难！”
看着写的满满当当的黄纸，杨狱头疼不已：“这世道，想干个什么，也太难了……”
一阵毫无意义的发泄之后，杨狱在纸上重重的写出四个大字。
“劫富济贫！”
咬着牙，杨狱终于知道为什么外城会有那么多的混子，帮派了。
哪怕死了一茬又一茬还是前赴后继。
因为他们被吞并了土地，没有一技之长，没有本钱，没有背景，没有关系……
别的无路，想要活命，想要活的更好。
那就只有拼了这条命！
去欺负那些和他们一样，却更为懦弱的普通人。
杨狱将纸撕了个粉碎，扔了满屋，压下心中邪念，口中喃喃的念着：
“遵纪守法……”
一番洗漱之后，在拐弯抹角的将老爷子可能没死的消息告知婆婆，好一番安慰之后。
杨狱才裹着断刀，揣着从王六哪里搜刮来的最后几钱银子出了门。
北大街，不如南大街繁华，可比之外城还是好了太多，酒馆、赌坊、茶馆、药铺、妓院都不缺。
且因为城中有钱有势的多去南城，反而人流更多，生意更好。
摊贩更多，也更鱼龙混杂。
乡绅、武馆弟子、帮派、混子、小偷……

无所不有。
漫无目的的走在街上，杨狱寻思着怎么搞钱，突然感觉到胸口微震。
“暴食之鼎？难道是有新的‘食材’？之前好似并没有这样的能力……”
杨狱一喜，随即扫向两旁的摊位，却发现并无异样。
再回头，却见一个汉子蹲坐在道旁，低声呜咽着。
这汉子穿的破破烂烂，脸上有伤有血，抱着个破布袋，面色惨然。
“大哥这是怎么了？伤得挺重……”
杨狱心中一动，上前问询。
“唉~”
中年人苦笑着抹去眼泪，指了指包袱，叹着气说着自己的境遇。
汉子名叫韩六子，家住外城，前些日子孩子染了重病，花光积蓄还是没能保住命。
这次来内城，就是为了变卖家里留下的东西，给孩子办后事。
却不想因为没钱交摊位费，被几个混子一顿暴打，摊位掀了不说，钱也被抢了去抵摊位费。
说到最后，几乎就又流下泪来。
杨狱心中一软，叹了口气：“还有些什么，让我瞧瞧吧。”
这年头，命苦的人太多，心善的太少。
便是自己，若非‘暴食之鼎’颤动，只怕也会下意识的忽略了这坐在道旁哭泣的汉子吧？
非是他心中没有善念，着实是这样的事情太过普遍，而他，也根本没有办法。
“谢谢小兄弟。”
擦去眼泪，韩六子

“这书？”
杨狱随意翻看了一下，不禁摇头。
这些东西都没什么价值，几本书破损的严重不说，还只是些老掉牙的话本故事。
不能说是一文不值，但也就值那么几文了。
似乎都不是……
杨狱眸光闪了闪，看向了包裹这些杂物的皮革。
这一看，胸口暴食之鼎的颤动顿时加剧。
“韩大哥，你想卖多少钱？”
杨狱伸手入怀。
“我……”
韩六子脸色有些发红，低着头呐呐道：“我，小兄弟，你看着给吧……”
“我身上只有七八钱的银子了……”
将银子递过去，微一犹豫，杨狱又从怀里掏出一只银钗，银镯，一并塞给了韩六子。
这却是他从那王六的姘头身上得来，没有敢去‘销赃’的首饰。
“哪里要这么多？”
韩六子脸庞更红，连连摆手，心中羞惭不已。
“你就收下吧！”
硬将东西塞进韩六子的怀里，将破布杂物一并拿走，杨狱稍显心安，笑着道：
“韩大哥你或许不信，可这笔买卖，说不定是我比你更占便宜。”
“小兄弟说笑了。”

韩六子自然不信自家这些破烂会有多大便宜可占，一阵道谢后才将银钱收下。
“实不相瞒，刚才那一会，我几乎想要持刀抢劫……”
韩六子神色黯淡下去：
“这狗日的世道不让人活啊……”
杨狱沉默。
许久后才安慰道：“一定会好起来的……”
“希望吧。”
韩六子不抱希望，问了杨狱的名字，才小心翼翼的回转外城。
“这是什么皮？”
彻底两袖清风，杨狱心情却是大好，拿出最后几文钱来到茶馆要了杯茶水。
微微闭目间，就看到了漆黑鼎壁上新出现的一行文字。
【发现食材】
【食材：人皮卷】
【等级：可（下）】
【品质：优（上）】
【评价：取自活人身上的皮膜，质量尚可，更珍贵的，是其上所录之‘老母想尔服气录’】
【炼化可得‘老母想尔服气录’】
【当前炼化进度：不可炼化】
昨天断电，坑了……
content_en:
Chapter 13 New Ingredients
Falling off a cliff and getting an unexpected encounter is a scene that can only be found in story-telling novels.
Yang Yu had never thought that his old man would have such an opportunity before, and he felt happy and worried at the same time.
It is certainly gratifying that the old man has had an "adventure", but the cliff seems to be very high. There is nothing else on the cliff, and there is no water or food. I am afraid it will be very difficult at this time.
"I hope the old man can turn bad luck into good luck and bring good fortune in times of trouble..."
After being stunned for a while, Yang Prison sighed.
Heishan City is quite far away from Qingzhou. It takes more than a year to go back and forth. The roads on the road are changeable and mountainous.
Even if he wanted to find the old man, he was unable to do so for the time being.
Not to mention that Black Mountain City is very uneasy at this time. If I leave, my mother-in-law will be here alone, which will be even more dangerous.
"How should I explain it to my mother-in-law?"
Yang Yu rubbed his temples, turned over and jumped out of the outline, stretched out his hand from the side of the vat, and found the broken knife in his hand.
After thorough refining, he noticed a difference.
Holding the knife at this time, a feeling of harmony came to his heart, as if the knife was not only a knife, but became a part of his arm.
"Completely refining it, does it seem to really make a difference?"
Yang Yu's spirit was shaken, and he immediately looked at the small tripod on his chest.
Due to the diligent 'charging' during this period, even after the Broken Sword was completely refined, only a small part of the Cauldron of Gluttony was still cyan.
This also means that he can refine the second ingredient in as fast as three to five days, or as slowly as eight or nine days.
This speed depends on himself.
Shaking off the water drops on his body, Yang Yu held the knife in his hand and waved it around in the courtyard.
He holds the knife in his right hand, and his left hand forms a palm. His eyes are on the edge of the knife, and his body moves with the knife. As the knife technique changes, he sometimes holds the knife on the shelf to assist the knife's power.
Sometimes the hand presses the back of the knife and rolls it left and right, sometimes it bends the elbow and holds it horizontally, sometimes it tilts it up and pulls it down...
After wandering around for a while, Yang Yu felt that the broken knife was like a driving arm, moving according to his heart, with indescribable smoothness and comfort.
It's as if I have really been practicing for thirty or fifty years.
But not long after, Yang Yu sheathed his sword and retreated, panting slightly:
"In my memory, the old man could swing the sword eight hundred times with all his strength... Is my physique not as good as the old man?"
Yang Yu thought about it, it was true.
It has only been a year since I came to this world. I spent the first half of the year trying to maintain my health, but I didn't work hard in the second half of the year.
The only ones who are really diligent are these days.
In a short period of time, even with a medicinal bath, it is still not as good as the old man's physique that he has worked hard for for less than half his life.
"My skills may not be inferior to the old man's, but my strength and speed are far behind. In a real fight, the old man might not be able to kill me with just a few blows..."
"I'm afraid the old man also took a medicinal bath, but I don't know if the blood transfusion was successful?"
Wiping his body haphazardly, Yang Yu muttered in his heart.
"We have to make money..."
“How to make money quickly?”
The sky was dim and bright, and Yang Yu was crouching at the table, writing and drawing.
During the year he traveled through time, Yang Prison thought about making money more than once.
But they all died in the womb for various reasons. Even though the memory of the past life can help, it cannot withstand the constraints of this world.
"Trading business, selling salt and iron, brothels, gambling houses, smuggling, food, land annexation, serving as an official..."
On the paper, Yang Yu ranked the businesses he thought were the most profitable from low to high.
Compare your abilities and cross them off one by one.
The first thing to cross out is being an official.
Being an official is naturally the most profitable profession, bar none.
In three years, the magistrate will receive one hundred thousand snowflakes and silver. This is not just talk.
The richest people in Black Mountain City are not the three families of Chen, Wang, and Li who have been cultivating the city for decades, nor are they the Black Mountain Army stationed outside the city.
It was the county magistrate ‘San Chi Liu’.
He had only been a county magistrate for ten years, and he was already much richer than those gentry.
Liu Wenpeng, who is three feet high in the sky, is a well-known wealthy figure even in several other counties.
Secondly, it is food.
One cannot go without food for a day;You can abstain from eating meat, you cannot abstain from eating grains, but you still have to cross this off.
Food is a forbidden thing for three feet, and no one else can touch it.
Similarly, land annexation is impossible to achieve.
After becoming a queen, he crossed out unconditional smuggling, brothels, and gambling houses, and the only things in front of him were salt, iron, and merchants.
"Salt and iron, merchant..."
After circling these two choices, Yang Yu bit his pen holder and pondered.
The Ming Dynasty could not help but privately sell salt and iron, and there were quite a few people engaged in it. However, this business was complex and was jointly controlled by several large rural gentry in the inner and outer cities and several gangs in the outer cities.
The same is true for businessmen.
No matter whether in or out of town, if you want to do business, even if you just set up a stall to sell calligraphy and painting, you have to hand over 10% to the Yamen, and the remaining 20% ​​goes to the gang squires.
The rest is yours.
Without a background, no matter how good the business is, it will be eaten clean.
What's more, he doesn't have that much time to run the business, let alone go out to purchase goods.
The same goes for salt and iron. Although he has a more efficient method for refining salt and iron, where is the foundation?
Among Old Man Wei's disciples, not only Hu Wan and a few others are nourished by life, but the others are all suffering haha.
"It's difficult, it's difficult!"
Looking at the yellow paper full of writing, Yang Yu had a headache: "In this world, it's too difficult to do anything..."
After a period of meaningless venting, Yang Yu wrote four big characters on the paper.
“Robbing the rich and giving to the poor!”
Gritting his teeth, Yang Yu finally understood why there were so many gangsters and gangs in the outer city.
Even if they die one after another, they still keep going.
Because their land was annexed, they have no skills, no capital, no background, and no connections...
There is no other way, I want to survive, I want to live a better life.
Then you have to fight for your life!
To bully ordinary people who are just like them, but more cowardly.
Yang Yu tore the paper into pieces and threw it all over the room. He suppressed the evil thoughts in his heart and murmured:
"Abide by the law..."
After washing up, I told my mother-in-law in a roundabout way that the old man might not be dead, and after some consolation.
Yang Yucai wrapped his broken knife and went out with the last few coins he had collected from Wang Liu.
North Street is not as prosperous as South Street, but it is much better than the outer city. There is no shortage of pubs, gambling houses, teahouses, drug stores, and brothels.
And because the rich and powerful people in the city often go to Nancheng, there will be more people and better business.
There are more vendors and a more mixed crowd.
Country squires, martial arts disciples, gangs, gangsters, thieves...
Everything.
Walking aimlessly on the street, Yang Yu was thinking about how to make money, and suddenly felt a slight shock in his chest.
"The Cauldron of Gluttony? Is there a new 'ingredient'? It seems that I didn't have such an ability before..."
Yang Yu was overjoyed and immediately scanned the stalls on both sides, only to find that there was nothing strange about them.
Looking back, I saw a man squatting by the roadside, whimpering softly.
This man was dressed in tatters, his face was bruised and bloody, he was holding a rag bag, and his expression was miserable.
"Brother, what's going on? The injury is quite serious..."
Yang Yu's heart moved and he stepped forward to ask.
"Alas~"
The middle-aged man wiped away his tears with a wry smile, pointed at the baggage, sighed and talked about his situation.
The man's name is Han Liuzi, and he lives in an outer city. His child got seriously ill a few days ago, and he spent all his savings but still couldn't save his life.
The purpose of coming to the inner city this time was to sell off the things left at home and take care of the funeral arrangements for the children.
But he didn't want to be beaten up by a few gangsters because he had no money to pay the stall fee. Not only did the stall be overthrown, but his money was also robbed to pay for the stall fee.
By the end, I almost shed tears again.
Yang Yu's heart softened and he sighed: "Let me see if there is anything else."
These days, there are too many people who are suffering, and too few who are kind-hearted.
Even I, if it weren't for the trembling of the 'Cauldron of Gluttony', I would probably have subconsciously ignored the crying man sitting by the road, right?
It’s not his heartThere are no kind thoughts in it. In fact, this kind of thing is too common, and he has no way at all.
"Thank you little brother."
Wipe away your tears, Han Liuzi
"This book?"
Yang Yu flipped through it casually and couldn't help but shake his head.
These things are of little value. Not to mention the serious damage to a few of the books, they are just old story books.
It can't be said that it is worthless, but it is only worth a few pennies.
It seems not...
Yang Yu's eyes flashed and he looked at the leather wrapping these sundries.
At this sight, the vibration of the Cauldron of Gluttony in his chest suddenly intensified.
"Brother Han, how much do you want to sell it for?"
Yang Prison stretched out his hand into his arms.
"I..."
Han Liuzi's face was a little red, he lowered his head and said: "I, little brother, just watch and give it..."
"I only have seven or eight coins left..."
After handing over the silver, Yang Yu took out a silver hairpin and a silver bracelet from his arms after a slight hesitation, and gave them to Han Liuzi.
This was the jewelry he got from Wang Liu's concubine, and he didn't dare to 'sell stolen goods'.
"Where can we get so many?"
Han Liuzi's face turned redder and he waved his hands repeatedly, feeling ashamed in his heart.
"Just accept it!"
After forcing the things into Han Liuzi's arms and taking away the rags and miscellaneous items, Yang Yu felt a little relieved and said with a smile:
"Brother Han, you may not believe it, but I may have taken advantage of this deal more than you."
"Little brother is joking."
Naturally, Han Liuzi didn't believe how much advantage he could take advantage of his own junk, so he accepted the money after thanking him for a while.
"To be honest, at that moment just now, I almost wanted to rob someone with a knife..."
Han Liuzi's expression darkened:
"No one can live in this shitty world..."
Yang Prison was silent.
After a long time, he comforted: "It will get better..."
"I hope so."
Han Liuzi gave up hope and asked Yang Yu's name before carefully turning back to the outer city.
"What kind of skin is this?"
It was completely refreshing, but Yang Yu was in a good mood. He took out his last few pennies and went to the teahouse to order a cup of tea.
Closing his eyes slightly, he saw a new line of text appearing on the dark cauldron wall.
【Discover ingredients】
[Ingredients: human skin rolls]
[Level: Yes (lower)]
[Quality: Excellent (upper)]
[Evaluation: The skin film taken from a living person is of acceptable quality. What is even more precious is the record of ‘My mother wants you to be convinced’]
[Refining can obtain ‘Old Mother Wants You to Conquer Qi Record’]
[Current refining progress: cannot be refined]
There was a power outage yesterday, which was a big problem...
